sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: carotenoid content gives it extra value. That adds a useful plant-pigment angle beyond the basic carb role most tubers play. Fairly filling for the calories. A practical strength for an energy food. Easy to use as a wholefood staple. Works cleanly in meals without needing much rescue from toppings or processing.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: The drawbacks next: naturally sweeter than some tubers. Still fine, but it is not the lowest-sugar energy food in the category. Healthiness depends on preparation.
